# PR body — P26.15 (EU tender sweep via TED Search API)

> Stacked on `devin/p26-14-federal-procurement` (PR #106). PR #107
> head `18b426f`. Ticket:
> `docs/tickets/P26.15__eu-tender-sweep.md` (SOURCES.14).
> Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P26.15.md`.

## What this lands

**The EU procurement surface — first non-US procurement tier.** TED
(Tenders Electronic Daily) is the OJ S notice surface for ~30 countries:
Frontex, Europol, national police forces, and municipalities all publish
above-threshold contract notices there — the same surveillance signal the
municipal (P26.10) and federal (P26.14) tiers already cover. The TED
Search API (`POST https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search`) is a
**documented, keyless** public API — a credential-free international
expansion.

**Bounded sweep as data.** `[ted_eu_sweep]` in `procurement_vocab.toml`:
11 reviewed English keyword slices + 10 verified CPV slices, one
`PAGE_NUMBER` page each (`limit=250`, the API's page cap), verbatim TED
Expert-Search syntax (`FT~"…"`, `classification-cpv=…`), a rolling
`publication-date>=` bound carried in the POST body — never in claim
identity. Each target URL carries `#sig-slice=<id>` — never transmitted,
so every capture's `source_uri` names its slice and every claim carries
slice provenance.

**Typed `procurement_notice` claims** — publication-number external_id,
notice_type, title, buyer, seller (verbatim `winner-name`), country
(alpha-3 raw + reviewed alpha-2 identifier, never fabricated), amount,
posted_date, response_deadline, description, products (verbatim CPV
codes), place_of_performance (verbatim NUTS/city literals, never ISO
3166-2), `matched_keyword` (verbatim literal + byte-range locator; a
query term not found verbatim is NEVER asserted), and
`lifecycle_transition` (cn-* → rfp_issued, can-* → awarded).
**Procured ≠ deployed**: no deployment/device predicates anywhere.
Per-slice `ted_eu_slice` outcome rows record items_count /
total_notice_count / truncated — empty slices and refusals are
first-class run data.

**Rights — GL-GATE-06 flip.** The pre-registered `ted_eu` stub was
expanded and flipped `ingestion_permitted=true` under the delegated
blanket disposition: the SIMAP legal notice resolves verbatim — OJ S
notices "can be freely reused, for commercial or non-commercial purposes"
(Commission Decision 2011/833/EU), editorial CC BY 4.0, metadata CC0 →
`CC-BY-4.0` with attribution. Packet:
`docs/build/reports/rights/ted_eu.md`. 76 → 77 loadable.

**Wiring.** `api.ted.europa.eu` `/v3/` API-mode allowlist entry (30/min
reviewed budget vs 700/min published fair-use; robots.txt 404 → no
policy exists, RFC 9309 §2.3.1.4); `live_targets.toml` seed slice;
`ops/cadence.toml` monthly `sig-ingest-ted-eu` / `sig-sched-ted-eu`
(`0 6 5 * *` Etc/UTC, no secret binding); `runner.py` source map +
`ted_eu_slice` serialization; `live_dispositions` stub row removed.

**Tests.** Real-capture fixture (two authentic Polish
video-surveillance notices) + 23 tests covering target generation,
query syntax, POST body on the wire, fail-closed envelope checks, i18n
extraction, verbatim claims + locators, country map honesty, per-slice
outcomes, replay/shadow determinism, 429/disappearance handling, gate
behavior, no-credential path, generated-slice provenance resolution,
end-to-end fixture run.

**Provenance fix (commit `666fc31`).** Run-1 inspection found generated
sweep slices weren't registered on `ctx.resolved_targets`, so
post-capture `source_uri` lookups missed them — outcome rows and claim
`evidence.notice_provenance` carried null slice provenance. `discover()`
now registers generated targets for all three generated sweeps
(`ted_eu`, `usaspending`, `sam_gov`) — the same mechanism `discover_more`
continuations use — and the TED prov dict guards `str()` on absent
values (no literal `"None"`). Because `evidence` sits inside
`content_digest`, the next hosted run re-asserts TED claims as new rows
with richer evidence — the honest append-only correction path, recorded
in the run ledger.

## Verification

- `make check` green: lint, format, mypy (231 files), **3,338 passed**,
  verify-gen clean.
- `sig-connectors validate`: 198 registered / 77 loadable / 0 flip-ready.
- `sig-ops cadence --check`: every loadable live-target source has a
  cadence row.
- **Local live proof** (bounded, `--sink memory`): 22 slices, all HTTP
  200, 0 refusals/limits/drift, **69,546 claims**, identical capture
  digests on rerun — committed run rows under
  `docs/build/reports/live_runs/`.
- **Hosted:** `sig-ingest-ted-eu` job + `sig-sched-ted-eu` monthly
  scheduler (`0 6 5 * *`) deployed. Three executions, all `ok` /
  exit 0, 22 captures, 69,546 emitted, 0 refusals/limits/drift:
  - `ccz7t` (52m28s, image `sha256:752e3e19`): spine
    285,588 → **352,268** (+66,680 after content-keyed dedupe).
  - `nv8kj` same-image rerun (45m14s): 17/22 slices byte-identical →
    **+0 on those**; the 5 slices moved by new OJ S publications added
    **+14,371** content-keyed rows (fully attributed — the only
    execution in the window; every per-notice predicate +608).
  - `59gtq` on the fixed image `sha256:d5d84b6d` (49m35s): **all 22
    outcome rows carry populated slice provenance** (the `666fc31`
    fix verified hosted) → +66,680 richer-evidence rows, the recorded
    append-only correction. Spine total **433,319**; the 2026-10-05
    scheduled run dedupes against this generation.
  Full attribution in `runs/P26.15.md`.

Procured ≠ deployed throughout: a tender notice is procurement evidence
only — never deployment, device count, or operational state.
